info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Tips-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Tips API provides access to a comprehensive list of tips related to food delivery services. This API serves as a resource for developers looking to enhance user experiences through curated advice on effective delivery practices and customer interactions. Typical consumers include food delivery platforms, logistic companies, and developers seeking to integrate tip suggestions into their applications. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can optimize their service offerings and improve operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current tip information for deliveries. It provides insights into the recommended tip amounts based on various factors, helping customers make informed decisions about gratuity.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve tipping information for deliveries. It should contain necessary parameters in JSON format to specify the desired tipping details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the delivery tip information.
